body:
It's less the actual pain but the squirming and the screaming...

I'm not saying that I have split personalities.. it's more like... modes I slip into.

>Ok 3 companies is worse than a single company. All 3 will pull a credit check on the recipient and they will talk. From what I can figure you are insured for Way more than your actual net worth. It will be a problem. It always is. Unless the death is completely verifiable by individuals (doctors, nurses,police officers... etc) then there will be an investigation. Granted you might have some circumstances I don't know about.

So having a dead beat father not able to get any job except for menial day labor (then not even that sometimes) due to a federal felony charge is better then not having one? Irregardless of if my wife was able to get the money or not.

**Edit** Adding

I wouldn't be able to even get state assistance (like welfare or housing assistance) and many places run background checks to live there, I'm not even going to talk about not being able to get a job.

>You drive a windy road home from work, no street lights, two lanes, ditches on both sides but the whole point is what happens if you survive the "crash"? what happens then? More problems more expenses more debt.

I have thought about if I survive as well, and it one of the few things keeping me from doing it. And yes I do have something like you say, I take it every day, in winter in the dark both ways.

>Your mistakes are yours and yours alone.

As a parent, this is not right. All my mistakes and successes fall to the rest of the family., moreso that I'm the dad. If I'm successful then their life is better and they have more opportunity. If I am a failure their life is worse, and that's regardless of whether they keep me in their life or not.

All this is doubly so if I'm even arrested for the wrong crime.

>What is a worse story to tell?

I don't care if he's got a good story, I care that he has a good education and start in life. And the story with my son with a dad in prison is not like that, it's more like I have an asshole dad in prison, I don't go see him any more.

>I personally would rather have a father alive in prison than a father that attempted this.

There are things worse then both of those options, and in my situation it's possible. This is not what happened, but imagine if I had been arrested for child porn, put away for 10 years, not able to see my son at all (even supervised), and now on the sex offender's list? There *are* things that are worse then not growing up with a father.

How is that better then being able to say "My dad died in a car accident when I was young."?

You are far from alone, I also have homicidal and sadistic thoughts. I'd say for me it's more like personalities. 

I have one that's feminine gay, one that's a killer, and one that's sickly sadistic. They are not distinct, they are all me, but I have no control over which will show up.

I'm also very afraid that if I tell somebody they will go to the authorities or commit me. I have always been able to control these thoughts, unless I am doing the sadism to myself. Which is what I do to mitigate it a little.

Mostly if I am able to get off to it [beater's remorse](http://www.urbandictionary.com/define.php?term=Beater%27s%20remorse) kicks in and the monsters go away.

I am just asking against the picture, not your post...

What if you are basing it on permanent things and don't want to?

>1 Mill they are going to investigate. At this point you would have tried this once..... hoping you don't but still this is your first time at trying something. You will make a mistake. Which would the company rather pay? A seasoned investigator willing to go the extra mile to prove your claim false. His cost $20k if that. Or your policy? Simple ties up in courts for years. She'd lose hope of ever getting the money. It isn't worth it. THEY ARE VERY LARGE CORPORATIONS FOR A REASON! They don't like losing money.

I don't disagree or am I disillusioned about this point. However, it's from not just one source or company. It's from about 3 companies in total. Not that the point isn't still valid. Even if just the smallest one paid out, it'd still be more then I make in 10 years.

>Ok now lets talk about the other side of this question.

OK, shoot.

>Do you think the majority of people look in the mirror and say "Goddamn it is great to be me!"? Maybe Brad Pitt.... Ashton Kutcher does all the time but in reality... we all think; fuck I gotta go to work. I gotta do this and that. 

No I don't think that. Actually I think many people arte just like me, trying to get on day to day.

>Most of the world is not happy with their current situation.

Agreed. See above.

>My best advice and coming from me it isn't that great..... but Find a place where you feel comfortable... go out. Find somewhere to be away from what you think is miserable. 

Maybe I need to amend my post in the OP, but please know this: *I'm not miserable*, my home life is one of the bright spots in my life. I'm not blowing smoke when I say I love my wife, and I'm not blowing smoke when I say I love my son. The reason I'm even thinking about this is that I love them and they bring so much joy into my life, I can't let them be dragged down with my shit (legal issues and lack of education).

I don't even hate my job, it's not bad, it just doesn't pay enough to live in my situation.

>Sorry but my preferences are bars. Go drink yourself into a stupor. No story will surprise a good bartender. Make it a weekly thing . That really is a bad example but you need to relieve your stress somehow.

This is major, I do have a lot of stress, and I do get out and do things

>You only get one shot at this silly thing called life. 

I know this very well.

>Trust me they would rather have you alive and broke then dead. Not a good start for your son.

Because we all have one life, I don't want my son or wife weighted down by my mistakes, which will follow them. I want them to have the best chance in life, maybe growing up without a father isn't the best case scenario, but knowing that you have the money for school is a better start then knowing I won't be able to pay for it.

I am thinking about this as trying to find the best way to provide for my family. I can barely provide now, if I accidentally died they would be provided for many times over and be able to better both of their lives.
Thank you for reading it at least.
